entry.title: Sea of Stars
entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：$9.99 → $5.99 [$5.99 ~ $9.99]）

All Price Information

Price：$5.99

Application Description

Promising the Sabotage touch in every system, Sea of Stars aims to modernize the classic RPG formula in terms of turn-based combat, storytelling, exploration and interactions with the environment, while still offering a hearty slice of nostalgia and good old, simple fun. It tells the story of two Children of the Solstice who will combine the powers of the sun and moon to perform Eclipse Magic, the only force capable of fending off the monstrous creations of the evil alchemist known as The Fleshmancer. Traverse seamlessly through the world with a navigation system that breaks free from the classic bound-to-the-grid tileset movement and fight enemies in an immersive take on the genre; no random encounters, no transitions to separate battlefields, and no grinding. FEATURES - Engaging turn-based combat: Along with timed hits, combat features combo attacks, boosting, and a strategic "locks" system, all in an immersive take on the genre; no random encounters, no transitions to separate battlefields, and no grinding. - Full-on dynamic lighting: Our custom-made render pipeline allows the creation of a breathtaking world coming to life by pushing the limits of 2D pixel-art games. - A story-rich adventure: Sometimes epic, sometimes silly, and other times emotional, Sea of Stars does its RPG duty of exploring classic themes of adventure and friendship, while also being chock-full of the unexpected twists and events you’d expect from a Sabotage production. - A world you can touch: Sailing, cooking, fishing, stopping by a tavern to listen to a song or play the infamous tabletop game known as "Wheels"... every system has been designed to deliver an experience that pays respect to retro classics, while rethinking in some areas to offer a smooth and modernized experience. CAREFULLY REDESIGNED FOR MOBILE - Revamped interface – exclusive mobile UI with complete touch control - Game Center achievements - Cloud Save – Share your progress between iOS devices - Compatible with MFi controllers - iPhone 16 Optimization (including Pro Max) Important notice: Due to limited RAM, the following devices may not provide a stable experience and the game may not run as smoothly as intended: "iPhone Xr, iPhone SE (2nd Gen, 2020) iPad Mini (5th Gen), iPad Air (3rd Gen), iPad (8th & 9th Gen)" For the best experience, we do not recommend playing on these models.

entry.title: Dungeon Clawler
entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：$6.99 → $3.99 [$3.99 ~ $6.99]）

All Price Information

Price：$3.99

Application Description

Dungeon Clawler is a Roguelike Claw Machine Deckbuilder. Build your unique deck, fight enemies by grabbing weapons and items from a claw machine and find special artefacts that help you on your quest to reclaim something you lost... Aim carefully to claw your way through this dungeon! FEATURES: - Unique Claw Machine Mechanic: Control a real-time claw machine to snatch weapons, shields, and items from the claw machine. Every grab counts, so plan your strategy and defeat enemies with precision. - Roguelike Dungeon Exploration: Traverse procedurally generated dungeons that change with every run, offering new challenges, enemies, and treasures every time you play. - Innovative Deckbuilding Strategy: Collect and upgrade your item pool with powerful weapons, items, and trinkets. With countless combinations, create your ultimate strategy to conquer the dungeons. - Epic Boss Battles: Engage in intense boss battles and unlock special perks aka paws with every victory. - Endless mode: Even after beating the dungeon boss, the run doesn’t end, but can go on forever. How deep into the dungeon can you venture? - 4 Difficulty Modes: Beat the dungeon in normal, hard, harder and nightmare mode. - Unique Characters: Choose from multiple heroes, each with their own unique abilities and playstyles. Discover the best combinations to suit your dungeon-crawling strategy. - Engaging Storyline: The evil dungeon lord has stolen your rabbit paw and you replaced it with a rusty claw. Fight your way through the dungeon to reclaim your lost limb and fortune! - Stunning Art & Sound: Immerse yourself in the colorful, hand-drawn world of Dungeon Clawler with its dynamic soundtrack and beautifully crafted visuals. WHY PLAY DUNGEON CLAWLER? Dungeon Clawler brings together the strategic depth of deckbuilders with the thrilling unpredictability of roguelike dungeon crawlers and the fun of a claw machine mechanic. Each run offers something new, with endless strategies to discover and enemies to defeat. If you're seeking a fresh deck-builder with infinite replayability, this is the game for you. EARLY ACCESS: HELP SHAPE THE FUTURE! Dungeon Clawler is currently in Early Access, and we're committed to making it even better with your feedback! Expect frequent updates, new content, and improvements as we continue to enhance the game. By joining now, you can help shape the future of Dungeon Clawler and be part of our growing community. JOIN THE ADVENTURE TODAY! Download Dungeon Clawler now and begin your journey through ever-changing dungeons. Can you master the claw and reclaim your paw? The dungeon awaits! ABOUT STRAY FAWN We are an indie game development studio from Zurich, Switzerland. Dungeon Clawler is our fourth game and highly appreciate your support!

Application Description

Wingspan is a relaxing, award-winning strategy card game about birds for 1 to 5 players. Each bird you play extends a chain of powerful combinations in one of your three habitats. Your goal is to discover and attract the best birds to your network of wildlife preserves. You are bird enthusiasts—researchers, bird watchers, ornithologists, and collectors—seeking to discover and attract the best birds to your network of wildlife preserves. Each bird extends a chain of powerful combinations in one of your habitats. Each habitat focuses on a key aspect of the growth of your preserves. In Wingspan up to 5 players compete to build up their nature preserves in a limited number of turns. Each beautiful bird that you add to your preserve makes you better at laying eggs, drawing cards, or gathering food. Many of the 170 unique birds have powers that echo real life: your hawks will hunt, your pelicans will fish, and your geese will form a flock. entry.title: Selene: Shift Calendar
entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：$2.99 → Free [Free ~ $2.99]）

All Price Information

Price：Free

Application Description

Selene — the shift calendar made for shift workers. The go-to scheduling app for nurses, doctors, railway staff, on-call support teams and anyone who works a rotating roster. * Before you buy (important) This app is built for one shift per day. If you regularly have several different shifts within a single day, it is not the right fit for you. No ads. No in-app purchases. No account or sign-in required. FEATURES · Automatic rotation — if you work a fixed pattern, enter it once and your whole calendar is generated instantly. · Manual scheduling — if your shifts are irregular, Selene handles that too: filling in a whole month takes less than ten seconds. · Colleague calendars — create as many shift calendars as you like, see them together in the Overview, and compare who is working on any given day. · Shift swaps — swapping shifts is part of the job. Record a swap in a couple of taps. · Clear statistics — shift totals at a glance. Pick any date range, pick any person, get the breakdown instantly. · Notes and events — keep track of anything that makes a day special. · iCloud sync — back up and restore through your Apple Account. Your data stays safe and follows you across your devices. · Beautiful themes — a large collection of hand-designed themes, all included, each with its own character. · Custom app icons — your Home Screen doesn't have to look like everyone else's. · DIY calendar layout — show more detail or keep it minimal. Combine a layout with a theme and make the calendar your own. · Widgets — put your shifts on the Home Screen and check them without opening the app. · Selene is updated continuously, so the experience keeps getting better. Thank you for supporting an independent developer.
